key_finding: stock_barcode is a full-screen barcode client action supporting receipt/delivery/internal/inventory picking types; scan dispatch is a step-state machine (source→product→lot→destination) with GS1-128 multi-AI parsing via barcodes_gs1_nomenclature; lot auto-creation is conditional on picking type use_create_lots/use_existing_lots flags; no dependency on stock_picking_wave.

claims.summary: Depends on barcodes, stock, web_tour only. No wave/batch dependency.
StockMoveLine adds product_barcode (related), location_processed (bool), dummy_id (virtual key).
_get_client_action() builds fullscreen ir.actions.client dict; use_form_handler system param reverts to form view.
get_barcode_view_state() serializes picking + lines + group flags + type settings in one RPC call.
on_barcode_scanned() resolves: product → packaging → source package → dest package → dest location; or GS1 typed parse.
_check_product() increments qty_done or creates new move line with qty_done=0 for tracked products.
_check_destination_location() splits lines when qty_done < product_uom_qty to preserve unfulfilled reservation.
Barcode kanban domain: code in (incoming, outgoing, internal). All three types are supported.
/scan_from_main_menu tries: open existing picking → open new picking by type → open new internal by location.
/get_set_barcode_view_state combines write + state read in one call; company from cids cookie.
get_all_products_by_barcode() returns up to 10k products + packaging entries keyed by barcode string.
read_product_and_package() fetches product fields and quant-based package/owner for lot lines.
get_all_locations_by_barcode() returns barcode→location dict with parent_path for JS child-of checks.
stock_barcode.lot wizard handles lot scan events; duplicate serial scan raises UserError.
validate_lot() calls get_lot_or_create() when use_existing_lots=True; otherwise stores lot_name string. Auto-creation confirmed.
AI01=GTIN/product(14-digit identifier), AI10=lot(alpha,20char), AI17=expiry(YYMMDD date), AI37=quantity(integer).
gs1_decompose_extended() iterates rules sequentially, returns all AIs as ordered list from a single composite scan.
Scan step machine: source→product→lot→destination. Steps auto-registered by _step_ prefix. Steps bypassed per mode.
PickingClientAction maps picking_type_code: incoming=receipt(skip src scan), outgoing=delivery(skip dest scan), else=internal.
Each scan increments qty_done directly. Commit on O-BTN.validate (button_validate). Immediate-transfer flag from server state.
stock.inventory has dedicated barcode client action; serializes theoretical_qty per line for comparison against scan counts.
Settings: nomenclature_id (GS1 toggle), keyboard shortcuts group (all users), keyboard_layout (deprecated).

migration_risk_flags: stock.inventory model removed in Odoo v16+ — inventory client action requires adaptation to stock.quant
immediate_transfer field semantics changed in v16+
product_packaging barcode path in on_barcode_scanned must survive packaging model changes
lot_name string vs lot_id M2O dual path in validate_lot must be preserved in any port
barcodes.barcode_events_mixin must exist in target version for on_barcode_scanned server-side dispatch
